title: Vector Storm
tagline: Survive the geometry. Outlast the swarm.

controls.move: WASD or left stick - 8-directional ship movement
controls.aim: mouse cursor or right stick - independent firing direction
controls.fire: left mouse / right trigger - continuous fire while held
controls.bomb: space / left trigger - clears all enemies on screen, limited stock

core_loop: Spawn waves of geometric enemies (snakes, diamonds, pinwheels, gravity wells)
Player ship strafes around a single-screen arena while shooting
Each kill increments the score multiplier (capped); dying resets multiplier
Survive 60 seconds → wave clears, brief pause, next wave spawns harder
Game over on running out of lives; high score persists in localStorage
art_direction: Neon vector graphics on near-black background. Bloom glow on every sprite. Particle trails. Bullets are bright cyan lines. Enemies are pure-color geometric shapes drawn with Phaser.Graphics (NOT sprites - vector primitives).
audio_direction: Pumping electronic beat (loop). Distinct enemy-spawn synth zaps. Satisfying bass kick on every kill. Multiplier tick rises in pitch as multiplier climbs.
iconic_moments: Multiplier number swelling 2x scale on kill
Bomb explosion: white flash + radial wave
First gravity well of the run pulls the camera
